statement.notes: The only field requested for extraction was 'depreciation_and_amortization'. This was directly mapped from the line item 'Depreciation, amortization, and other' in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash from operations' section of the Consolidated Cash Flow Statement. All three available periods (years ended June 30, 2025, 2024, and 2023) have been included. The values are in millions (scale: 1E6) of US Dollars (USD).
